ready-for-love-quiz.name: Ready for Love quiz
ready-for-love-quiz.share: I got "{title}" on the Ready for Love quiz 👀 Eight questions on what you want, your standards and what you are healing from. Take it and send me yours.

grounded.title: Clear on my standards, and ready.
grounded.summary: You know what you want and you hold your standards. When a man falls short, you notice and you act on it. Keep guarding your time. Your standards are your best filter.

close.title: Close. A little clarity and I'm there.
close.band: Close, and a little clarity will sharpen it
close.summary: There is real ground under you. In a few areas, pressure from family or an old hurt is deciding for you. You can learn to catch that, and it is not a flaw.

pour-into-you.title: Pouring into me first.
pour-into-you.band: A season to pour into you first
pour-into-you.summary: Pressure, an old hurt or not yet knowing what you want is steering the wheel. Nothing is wrong with you. You can take time to get to know yourself before you choose anyone.

green-red-flags-checker.name: Green and Red Flags checker
green-red-flags-checker.share: I checked the green and red flags. My read: "{title}" 👀 Tick what you are actually seeing in him and get your own read.

healthy.title: This is looking healthy.
healthy.summary: He shows care, he is consistent and he respects you, and you have ticked no red flags so far. A green flag is proven over months. One good week does not prove it.

watch.title: Mostly good. A couple of things to watch.
watch.band: Mostly good, with things to watch
watch.summary: The care is real, and so are one or two patterns worth naming. Small red flags left unsaid tend to grow. Raise them once, in private, and watch how he responds.

red-outweighs.title: The red is outweighing the green.
red-outweighs.summary: That gap tells you something. Loving harder or waiting longer rarely closes it. If he keeps hurting you, stepping back is self-respect.

mixed.title: A real mix. Read it carefully.
mixed.summary: There is good here and there are real red flags. Ask yourself whether the reds are things he can change, or the kind that wear you down over time.

situationship-checker.name: Situationship checker
situationship-checker.share: I took the Situationship checker. Verdict: "{title}" 😅 Six questions to see if it is a relationship or a situationship. Take it and send me yours.

going-somewhere.title: This is going somewhere.
going-somewhere.summary: He is consistent, he talks about the future and he treats you as his. If you want it named, asking is fair and easy.

undefined.title: Undefined. I deserve a straight answer.
undefined.summary: There is something real, but it is vague enough to keep you guessing. You can ask him what you are and where this is going.

choose-you.title: Situationship. I'm choosing me.
choose-you.summary: How consistent he is, whether he plans a future with you and how he shows up in public do not match what you want. Waiting will not change that. You can choose yourself.

red-flag-radar.name: Red Flag Radar
red-flag-radar.share: I got "{title}" on the Red Flag Radar 🚩 He goes quiet for three days. Every ex was crazy. Green flag, let's talk or red flag? Make your calls and send me yours.

sharp.title: My radar is sharp.
sharp.summary: You read men the way Wholesome Girlies does on most of these. You see care when it is there, you ask about the grey areas, and you do not excuse the real red flags. Keep trusting what you see.

soft.title: I give him the benefit of the doubt.
soft.summary: You see the best in people, and that is a good thing. On a few of these, you waved through something that needs a conversation or a step back.

strict.title: I cut first and ask questions later.
strict.summary: You protect yourself fast. On a few of these, you called red what Wholesome Girlies would talk through first. One conversation can tell you more than a quick exit.

warming-up.title: My radar is still warming up.
warming-up.summary: Your calls went both ways, softer than Wholesome Girlies on some and stricter on others. The more closely you watch what a man does, the sharper your radar gets.

is-he-husband-material.name: Is He Husband Material?
is-he-husband-material.share: I got "{title}" on Is He Husband Material? 👀 Does his word match what he does? Can he say sorry? Check your man and send me your result.

showing-it.title: He's giving husband material.
showing-it.summary: From what you have seen, he is consistent, respectful and serious about a future with you. Keep watching over time, because character shows most under pressure, and talk through the big things before you commit.

promising.title: Promising, with questions to ask.
promising.summary: There is good here, and there are gaps you have not settled yet. Pick the two answers that bothered you most and raise them with him. How he responds is part of your answer.

not-yet.title: Not husband material yet.
not-yet.summary: Right now, what you see does not add up to the man you want to marry. People can grow, but you do not have to wait while he does. Decide what you need to see from him, and by when.

girls-girl-quiz.name: Are You a Girl's Girl?
girls-girl-quiz.share: I got "{title}" on the Are You a Girl's Girl? quiz 👀 Ten friendship situations, from aso ebi money to a 1am breakup call. Take it and send me your result.

certified.title: I am a certified girl's girl.
certified.summary: You hype your friends, protect their dignity and tell them the hard thing when it matters. You do not confuse support with agreement. Your friends know you will show up and still tell them what they need to hear.

ride-or-die.title: I am a ride-or-die girl's girl.
ride-or-die.summary: You defend your friends fast and love them loudly. Sometimes you enter a battle before asking if they want one. Keep the loyalty, but let your friend choose what help looks like.

lowkey.title: I am a lowkey girl's girl.
lowkey.summary: You may not write a long birthday post, but you send the message and turn up in person. Your care happens in private, where your friend can feel it. Say it out loud sometimes, because she may not always know.

own-time.title: I am a girl's girl on my own time.
own-time.band: Love that arrives a little late
own-time.summary: You love your friends, but work, family and your own life can get loud. You may miss the launch post or return the call later, but the affection is still there. A reminder and one small action can help your love arrive on time.

pick-me.title: I am a pick-me, and I know it.
pick-me.summary: The pick-me habit keeps turning every room into an audition, with your girls cast as supporting characters. Next time, pause before you move and choose your friend once.

3am-group-chat.name: 3am Group Chat
3am-group-chat.share: I made a 3am chat card 😂 "{title}" Pick your 3am thought, get a friend's reply and send it to a new mum.
3am-group-chat.note: This game is for fun. It runs on this device, and nothing anyone answers is saved or sent.

card.title: Even at 3am, my girls reply.
card.summary: You picked your 3am thought and a friend answered. Save the card, or send it to the friend who just had a baby. She may be awake.

delulu-or-clear-eyed.name: Delulu or Clear-Eyed?
delulu-or-clear-eyed.share: I got "{title}" on the Delulu or Clear-Eyed? quiz 👀 Ten talking-stage situations. Take it and send me yours.
delulu-or-clear-eyed.note: This game is for fun. It runs on this device, and nothing anyone answers is saved or sent.

certified-delulu.title: I am certified delulu.
certified-delulu.band: Reads the whole love story from one story view
certified-delulu.summary: You hear a maybe and plan the wedding. Your hope is lovely, and right now it is doing the work his actions should be doing. Next time he is vague, ask him one direct question before you decide what it means.

hopeful.title: I am hopeful, with one eye open.
hopeful.band: Gives him time and watches a little
hopeful.summary: You give people room and you wait to see if his actions match his words. That is a good start. Put a date on the waiting, so hope does not turn into six months, and ask when you are unsure.

clear-eyed.title: I am clear-eyed and still soft.
clear-eyed.band: Warm, direct and hard to confuse
clear-eyed.summary: You listen to what he says and you watch what he does. When something does not add up, you ask the question instead of guessing. Keep doing that, and keep letting good men in.

case-closed.title: I am very clear-eyed. Case closed.
case-closed.summary: You do not wait around for a man to make up his mind, and you do not accept nonsense. Sometimes you close the door before he has had a chance to explain. Ask one question before you leave, so you go for the right reason.

how-do-you-love.name: How Do You Love?
how-do-you-love.share: I got "{title}" on the How Do You Love? quiz 👀 Ten everyday relationship moments. Take it and send me yours.
how-do-you-love.note: This game is for fun. It runs on this device, and nothing anyone answers is saved or sent.

reassurer.title: I love like a reassurer.
reassurer.band: Says it, checks in, keeps it warm
reassurer.summary: You love by staying close in words. You check in, say what you feel and like to hear it back. Tell the people you love what reassurance looks like for you, so they can give it before you have to ask.

space-keeper.title: I love like a space-keeper.
space-keeper.band: Gives room and shows it in actions
space-keeper.summary: You love by giving people room and showing it through what you do. You may say the words rarely, and you may need time alone to feel close again. Say it out loud sometimes, because someone who loves you may not read your quiet.

steady-one.title: I love like the steady one.
steady-one.band: The same love, week after week
steady-one.summary: You love through routine: the call at the same time and the plan you keep. People rely on you. Leave room for a surprise now and then, and say what you feel before it turns into habit.

all-in.title: I love like the all-in one.
all-in.band: Big heart, big gestures, full speed
all-in.summary: You love fast, loud and with everything you have. The surprise, the plan and the full effort show it. Pace yourself sometimes and check that the other person is moving at your speed.

how-well-do-you-know-me.name: How Well Do You Know Me?
how-well-do-you-know-me.share: I got "{title}" on How Well Do You Know Me? 👀 One of you answers ten questions, the other guesses. Play with your spouse and send me your score.
how-well-do-you-know-me.note: This game is for fun. Answers travel only in the private link between the two of you, never in a shared result.

back-of-my-hand.title: I know my spouse like the back of my hand.
back-of-my-hand.summary: You got nine or ten right. You remembered the small things. Keep asking, because answers can change.

well-with-surprises.title: I know my spouse well. They can still surprise me.
well-with-surprises.summary: You got seven or eight right. You know the big picture, and a few answers caught you out. Ask about those. They can start the best conversations.

half-and-half.title: Half right. My spouse still has stories for me.
half-and-half.summary: You got between four and six right. Busy seasons, work and children can take over the small talk. Try one question a day this week and see what you find out.

ask-more.title: My spouse still has plenty to tell me.
ask-more.summary: You got three or fewer right. Now you have plenty to ask about. Swap places, ask each other these questions out loud and take your time.

milestone-guess.name: Milestone Guess
milestone-guess.share: I got "{title}" on Milestone Guess 👶 Guess the age for eight baby milestones and see the real ranges. Play and send me your score.
milestone-guess.note: This game is for fun and learning. It is educational, not medical advice, and not yet reviewed by a clinician.

spot-on.title: I know when babies reach their milestones.
spot-on.summary: Your guesses were close on almost every milestone. Remember that the ages are ranges, and every baby moves at their own pace. If you ever have a worry about your own baby, ask at the clinic.

close.title: I was close on most baby milestones.
close.summary: You were near the usual age on most of them, and a few surprised you. The ranges are wider than many people think, and the sources are listed below. Every baby has their own pace.

own-clock.title: Every baby has their own clock, and now I know the ranges.
own-clock.summary: Milestone ages surprise a lot of parents, and the ranges are wide on purpose. You now have the ranges and the sources. A baby who reaches a milestone later than a friend's baby is often right inside the range.

mum-wrapped.name: Mum Wrapped
mum-wrapped.share: I got "{title}" on Mum Wrapped. My first six weeks with a baby, counted in cards. Try it and send me yours.
mum-wrapped.note: This game is for fun. It runs on this device, and nothing anyone answers is saved or sent.

night-shift-legend.title: I ran the night shift.
night-shift-legend.summary: A big share of what you logged happened between 10pm and 5am, and you were there for each tap. The night shift was yours.

milk-bar-manager.title: I kept the milk bar open.
milk-bar-manager.summary: Feeds were the biggest part of your six weeks, and you kept showing up for every one. That is real work.

visitor-hostess.title: I hosted the visitors and survived.
visitor-hostess.summary: Your door kept opening. You found the chairs, served the water and kept going with a new baby in the house.

cold-tea-queen.title: My tea went cold and I kept going.
cold-tea-queen.summary: A hot cup of tea and a new baby do not often meet. You made the next cup anyway.

one-tap-at-a-time.title: I took six weeks one tap at a time.
one-tap-at-a-time.summary: You logged what you could, when you could. Every tap was you showing up for your baby.

new-parent-bingo.name: New Parent Bingo
new-parent-bingo.share: I got "{title}" on New Parent Bingo 👀 Tick the newborn moments you have lived through, like checking the baby was breathing three times in one night. Play it and send me your score.
new-parent-bingo.note: This game is for fun. It runs on this device, and nothing anyone answers is saved or sent.

just-landed.title: We're still new at this.
just-landed.summary: You have lived only a few of these so far, or you are just starting. The rest will come, and every parent has a story for each one. Send the grid to the other parent and compare.

a-few-nights-in.title: We've lived a few of these.
a-few-nights-in.summary: You have been in the newborn days long enough to know these moments when they come. Ask the other parent to play on their own phone. You will find squares you each lived without the other knowing.

deep-in-it.title: We're deep in the newborn days.
deep-in-it.summary: More than half the grid has happened in your house. You know the diaper trips, the whispering and the 3am search. Send it to the group chat and see who has the higher score.

full-bingo.title: We've lived almost all of it.
full-bingo.summary: You have been through nearly every square. Newborn days make good stories, and yours are well stocked. Send the grid to a friend who is still expecting.

old-wives-tales-baby.name: Old Wives' Tales: True or False? Baby Edition
old-wives-tales-baby.share: I got "{title}" on Old Wives' Tales: Baby Edition 👀 Ten baby tales, True or False, each with a source. Play and send me your score.
old-wives-tales-baby.note: This game is for fun and learning. It is educational, not medical advice, and not yet reviewed by a clinician.

sharp.title: I know my baby facts from my baby tales.
sharp.summary: You got most of the baby tales right. Check the ones you missed, because the source and what to do instead sit under each answer. Send the game to a friend and see her score.

half.title: I knew half. I'm glad I checked the rest.
half.summary: Some baby beliefs are safe, some are not and some depend on age. Read the answers you missed and open the sources. A friend may enjoy the game too.

raised.title: I grew up on these baby tales. Now I check first.
raised.summary: These beliefs come from families who love their babies. A few are not safe, and the answers say plainly what to do instead. Take your own questions to your clinic or paediatrician.

old-wives-tales-pregnancy.name: Old Wives' Tales: True or False? Pregnancy Edition
old-wives-tales-pregnancy.share: I got "{title}" on Old Wives' Tales: Pregnancy Edition 👀 Ten pregnancy tales, True or False, each with a source. Play and send me your score.
old-wives-tales-pregnancy.note: This game is for fun and learning. It is educational, not medical advice, and not yet reviewed by a clinician.

sharp.title: I know my facts from my old wives' tales.
sharp.summary: You got most of the pregnancy tales right. Check the ones you missed, because the source sits under each answer. Send the game to a friend and see her score.

half.title: I knew half. The other half surprised me.
half.summary: Some of these tales are true, some are false and some depend. Look at the answers you missed and read the source. A friend may enjoy the game too.

raised.title: I grew up on these tales. Now I have the sources.
raised.summary: These beliefs come from families who care about the mother and the baby. Some are worth a second look, and the answers and sources are listed below. Take your own questions to your midwife or doctor.

omugwo-your-mum-or-his-mum.name: Omugwo: Your Mum or His Mum?
omugwo-your-mum-or-his-mum.share: I got "{title}" on the Omugwo: Your Mum or His Mum? quiz 👀 Nine omugwo dilemmas. Take it and send me yours.
omugwo-your-mum-or-his-mum.note: This game is for fun. It runs on this device, and nothing anyone answers is saved or sent.

team-my-mum.title: I am Team My Mum.
team-my-mum.band: Her own mother in her corner
team-my-mum.summary: You feel most at ease with your own mother, and that matters in the weeks after birth. Tell your husband and his mother early and warmly, so his family feels included, and find a part of the month that is theirs.

team-his-mum.title: I am Team His Mum.
team-his-mum.summary: You want to honour his family and follow the elder in the house. That can build a strong bond with his mother. Say what you need out loud too, because she can only help with what she knows.

team-both.title: I am Team Both.
team-both.summary: You want both families in. That takes planning: dates, roles and one person who explains the plan to everyone. If you agree it before the baby arrives, both mothers will feel valued.

team-just-us.title: I am Team Just Us, thank you.
team-just-us.band: Our house, our rhythm, family on visits
team-just-us.summary: You want to find your feet as a family first, with visits instead of a long stay. You are choosing a quiet start, and that rejects nobody. Tell both mothers early what you would love from them, so they can still be part of it.

pregnancy-cravings-tier-list.name: Pregnancy Cravings Tier List
pregnancy-cravings-tier-list.share: My cravings tier list is done 👀 "{title}" Rank suya, agege bread, puff-puff and more, then send me yours.
pregnancy-cravings-tier-list.note: This game is for fun. It runs on this device, and nothing anyone answers is saved or sent.

street.title: My S tier is pure roadside.
street.summary: You put suya, roasted corn or agege bread at the top. Roadside food won this round. Your tier list is ready for your Status.

sweet.title: My S tier is all sugar.
sweet.summary: You put puff-puff, chin chin, mango or a cold drink at the top. The sweet things won this round. Your tier list is ready for your Status.

pot.title: My S tier comes from the pot.
pot.summary: You put jollof, eba and soup, pepper soup or Indomie at the top. Your S tier is a full plate. Your tier list is ready for your Status.

mixed.title: My S tier has no rules.
mixed.summary: Your S tier has roadside food, sweet things and food from the pot, or it is very full. You refused to choose one side. Your tier list is ready for your Status.

put-a-finger-down-dating.name: Put a Finger Down: Dating Edition
put-a-finger-down-dating.share: Put a finger down: "{title}" 😅 Ten lines on talking stages, aunties and the ex who texts “hey stranger”. How many fingers do you have left? Send me yours.
put-a-finger-down-dating.note: This game is for fun. It runs on this device, and nothing anyone answers is saved or sent.

none-left.title: I have no fingers left.
none-left.summary: You have lived all ten. You know the talking stage, the aunties and the ex who texts. You are still here, and the group chat has the full story. Send it to your friends and see who has one left.

last-fingers.title: I'm down to my last fingers.
last-fingers.summary: You have lived nearly all of it. One or two lines have not found you yet. Send it to your friends and compare who has the most gist.

half-a-hand.title: I'm down to half a hand.
half-a-hand.summary: You have been through a fair share of dating, and you can tell a repeated line when you hear one. Compare with your friends and see who put down more.

mostly-up.title: Most of my fingers are still up.
mostly-up.summary: A few of these have found you, and most have not. Your friends will have stories for the rest. Send it to them and see how their hands look.

all-up.title: Nearly all my fingers are still up.
all-up.summary: Almost none of these has happened to you. Send it to your friends and let them tell you what they have lived.

visitors-bingo.name: Visitors Bingo
visitors-bingo.share: I got "{title}" on Visitors Bingo 👀 Tick everything your visitors said after the birth, from “He looks exactly like his father” to “Is she eating?”. Play it and send me your score.
visitors-bingo.note: This game is for fun and learning. It is educational, not medical advice, and not yet reviewed by a clinician.

first-guests.title: My first visitors are still on the way.
first-guests.summary: You have lived only a few of these so far. Keep the grid for later. Visitors are coming. Keep the grid and tick it after each visit.

a-few-visits-in.title: My house has had its share of visitors.
a-few-visits-in.summary: You have heard some of the classics. A few more are surely coming. Keep a bottle of sanitiser by the door.

open-house.title: My living room has been an open house.
open-house.summary: More than half the grid has walked through your door. You know who comes with food and who comes with advice. Send the game to another new mum and see whose visitors win.

full-house.title: I've hosted nearly every visitor.
full-house.summary: Nearly every visitor on the grid has been to your home. That is a lot of love and a lot of jollof. Send it to the group chat and see who beats you.

what-kind-of-mum.name: What Kind of Mum Will You Be?
what-kind-of-mum.share: I got "{title}" on the What Kind of Mum Will You Be? quiz 👀 Nine pregnancy moments. Take it and send me yours.
what-kind-of-mum.note: This game is for fun. It runs on this device, and nothing anyone answers is saved or sent.

planner.title: I am the planner mum.
planner.band: Lists, dates and a backup plan
planner.summary: You like to know what is coming. Your lists and your calendar keep you steady, and your family will lean on them. Leave room for plans to change, because babies like to surprise people.

soft-life.title: I am the soft-life mum.
soft-life.summary: You want this season to feel good, and you protect your joy. You pick what suits you and let the rest pass. Write down the two or three things you must not forget, so the soft life stays soft.

hype.title: I am the hype mum.
hype.band: Loud love and a full group chat
hype.summary: You celebrate everything, and your people feel it. You bring the energy and the community with you. Pick a few moments to keep just for yourself and your family.

naija-strict.title: I am the Naija-strict mum.
naija-strict.summary: You like order, you say what you mean and your home runs on a system. Your family always knows where they stand. Leave a little room for the days when the rules need to bend.

which-nigerian-parent.name: Which Nigerian Parent Are You?
which-nigerian-parent.share: I got "{title}" on the Which Nigerian Parent Are You? quiz 😂 Nine everyday moments. Take it and send me yours.
which-nigerian-parent.note: This game is for fun. It runs on this device, and nothing anyone answers is saved or sent.

remote-control.title: I am the remote control parent.
remote-control.summary: Your house has rules and everyone knows them. You decide fast, so your children always know what to expect. Leave a little room for a child to explain, because a good reason deserves a hearing.

ask-your-father.title: I am the "go and ask your father" parent.
ask-your-father.summary: You are a team player, or a very good manager. You pass the big decisions to the other parent and keep the peace. Make sure it is a decision you also agree with, so your children hear one voice.

long-speech.title: I am the long speech parent.
long-speech.summary: You turn every moment into a lesson, with a story, a proverb and the full background. Your children learn that you care about who they become. Keep a short version ready, because the long one is so good they only hear the first half.

soft-landing.title: I am the soft landing parent.
soft-landing.summary: You are the parent they run to. You say yes more than you planned to, and the house feels safe because of you. Pick one or two rules you will hold, so your yes stays a real yes.
